seo.title: Eternal Repos — Purpose-Built Ceremonial Mobility
seo.description: Standing beside families through the last goodbye — a dignified farewell for the one you've lost, and gentle support for those left behind.

hero.description: From the first call to the final rites, we stay beside your family — arranging all that a farewell asks for, gently and with dignity, so you can simply be with the one you've lost.

slides.title: Immediate transport, without delay
slides.line: A calm, private vehicle and a trained crew — we bring your loved one home gently, whatever the hour.

slides.title: A farewell in your tradition
slides.line: The hall, the flowers, the pandit, the permissions — every part of the rite arranged in your custom, at your pace.

slides.title: Care that stays, after
slides.line: Grief support, keepsakes and the practical affairs — we remain beside your family in the weeks that follow.

services.title: Everything a farewell asks for
services.description: From the first call to the weeks that follow — every part of the farewell, carried with dignity.

promise.quotePart1: The vehicle is our most visible promise of dignity —
promise.quotePart2: the care around it is our reason for being.
promise.description: We are here for the ordinary floor of decency: someone answers, the weight is carried, and nothing is ever sold to a family in its hardest hour.

lifeCircle.description: From a single thread, our care blooms two ways — a farewell for the one you've lost, and a steady hand for the family that remains.
lifeCircle.bloomAriaLabel: Two blooms of care growing from one thread
lifeCircle.closingQuote: You grieve. We'll carry the rest.

verses.verse1: Death is not extinguishing the light; it is only putting out the lamp because the dawn has come.
verses.verse2: The ones we love do not leave us — they become the light we carry.
verses.verse3: When words fail, we stay beside you.

firstDay.title: How the hardest day unfolds — with us beside you
firstDay.description: The shape of the day a family dreads — held, hour by hour, so they never face any of it alone.

beats.title: A voice answers
beats.desc: Whatever the hour — calm, unhurried, already moving.

beats.title: We come to you
beats.desc: We bring them home, gently, so nothing waits on you.

beats.title: The weight lifts
beats.desc: Everything a farewell asks for — arranged in your tradition:

beats.title: You are together
beats.desc: While we hold the rest, your family simply grieves.

ethos.title: Seven ethos
ethos.description: The commitments we publish in advance — each one you can hold us to.

items.title: A person, at any hour
items.desc: Never a menu, never "call back in the morning." A real voice, whenever you call.

items.title: A response you can rely on
items.desc: We set out without delay, and we tell you what to expect — so nothing is left to guesswork.

items.title: A written standard of care
items.desc: Our conduct and hygiene are published in full, so you can read them before you trust us.

items.title: Nothing asked twice
items.desc: What a family tells us once is recorded and carried throughout — no name, no detail, repeated in grief.

items.title: Nothing sold in that hour
items.desc: No options put to a family least able to refuse them. Arrangements are settled with care, never upsold.

items.title: Reverence as a discipline
items.desc: Not a temperament we hope for, but a standard we train, assess and hold our team to.

items.title: Present in the weeks that follow
items.desc: The care does not end when the vehicle leaves — we stay for what comes after.

vehicleSection.eyebrow: How we carry your loved one
vehicleSection.titleMain: The vehicle is the most visible part of our care —
vehicleSection.description: It carries the one you've lost with privacy and calm. But the real work is everything around it — the hands, the arrangements, the people who stay. The vehicle is simply where that care becomes something you can see.
vehicleSection.vehiclePreviewCaption: A quiet, private space — soft light, room to travel alongside.

configurator.title: Tell us where you are, and we'll point the way.
configurator.description: Choose what fits your moment — there is no wrong answer, and no obligation.

needs.q: Someone has just died and we need help right now.
We need a space, floral decor, or catering for the gathering.
We need support, obituaries, or guidance in the days after.
We want to plan ahead, or arrange financial cover.
We need intercity transfer or international repatriation.

partners.title: In active partnership with hospitals — meeting families where the need begins.
partners.description: We work in direct partnership with hospitals, hospices, and care facilities across Delhi NCR — stepping in with dignity right at the ward door so doctors and nurses can focus on healing, while families receive immediate, compassionate care.

items.title: In Partnership with Hospitals & Hospices
items.desc: We are in official partnership with leading hospitals across Delhi NCR. When a patient passes away, our empanelled team takes over at the ward door — handling all post-life transfers, mortuary coordination, documentation assistance, and compassionate family guidance so medical teams can stay focused on clinical care.
lifts: Hospital death slip & clearance documentation guidance
Zero logistics burden on hospital doctors & nursing staff
Compassionate, respectful bedside handholding for families

items.title: Care & retirement homes
items.desc: A familiar, gentle presence for residents' final journey — handled with the tenderness of people you've trusted with your families for years, and with respect for the relationships you've built.
lifts: Continuity of the care you gave

items.title: Faith institutions & communities
items.desc: We honour the rites of every tradition — coordinating with priests, temples, mosques, churches and gurudwaras so the farewell follows custom exactly, and nothing feels unfamiliar or rushed.

items.title: Civic bodies & trusts
items.desc: Dignified handling at scale — for communities, welfare programmes and the moments that ask for quiet public responsibility, delivered with the same respect we give every single family.

partners.hospitalNetworkDesc: Empanelled with leading hospital networks, critical care centres, and mortuaries across Delhi, Noida, and Gurugram for prompt bedside clearance, death slip documentation guidance, and dignified transfer.

mahaprayaan.title: Grief is easier carried together.
mahaprayaan.description: Mahaprayaan is a community initiative we stand beside — a gentle space for the conversations loss makes hard to start. Eternal carries the practical weight; Mahaprayaan holds the room to talk, remember and heal.
mahaprayaan.bannerAlt: Mahaprayaan, a community initiative — a space for the conversations we don't know how to start.

testimonials.title: Held, when it mattered most.
testimonials.description: Reflections from families we've stood beside, in their hardest hours.

items.quote: When my father passed away late at night, we felt completely helpless. Eternal stepped in with such gentle care — never a transaction, only quiet reverence, standing beside us the whole way.
items.name: Arjun Sharma

items.quote: They took care of the hospital paperwork, the transport, the priest — so my mother and I could just sit together in peace. Having someone truly care during our hardest hour made all the difference.
items.name: Meera Rastogi

items.quote: In a moment of overwhelming grief, Eternal gave us a calm sanctuary and gentle guidance through every step. We felt genuine warmth exactly when we needed it most.
items.name: Dr. V. K. Malhotra

testimonials.caption: A family we stood beside

eaqs.title: Questions families ask
eaqs.description: Straight answers to what most people want to know.

items.a: We are based at ATS Bouquet, Sector 132, Noida, and serve families across Delhi NCR — including Noida, Delhi and Gurugram.
We are built for the moments that cannot wait. Call the concierge and our team responds promptly, day or night, and sets out without delay.

items.q: Do you work with all communities and faiths?
items.a: Yes. We serve families of every community and faith, adapting arrangements to the rites and wishes that matter to you.
Call the concierge at +91 84486 61338, email care@eternalrepos.com, or use the contact page — and we will guide you gently from there.

finalCta.title: Standing Beside You in Your Time of Need.
finalCta.description: Whenever you're ready — for gentle guidance, immediate help, or quiet pre-planning — we're only a call away.
finalCta.supportLine: 24/7 Compassionate Support · Standing Beside Families Across India
